title: Chapter 356 Two Corpses
content:
Chapter 356 Two Corpses

It was the bodies of two men.

A man had a thin face and was angular. His long hair was tied behind his head with a ribbon, floating casually. His eyes were slightly closed. If it weren't for the strong dead aura of emitting a body, at first glance, he might just think he was just sleeping.

Another man looked even wilder, his upper body was exposed, and his body was filled with explosive muscles. His eyes were not closed, but instead opened them wide, staring at the end of the starry sky, with Full of unwillingness.

At this moment, the two corpses, without exception, exuded extremely terrifying pressure.

The mighty pressure caused the entire starry sky to collapse.

You know, these two people have been dead for many years.

If the two were in their lifetime, they wouldn't know how powerful they were.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng's eyes were filled with sadness.

Because he saw that these two people were strong men who broke up from the lower plane.

It turned out that someone had really broken the plane gap and came to this new world.

These two corpses have been here for many years. I think it has been a long time ago.

A sigh rang out from the starry sky.

Lu Daosheng was silent for a long time, looked at the two corpses, and slowly poked out his hand.

In an instant, scenes appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

In the picture, the silent starry sky is exactly the same as here, but the difference is that the picture is very comfortable and there is no sign of being destroyed.

And at this moment, a huge roar sounded.

The next moment, the space suddenly exploded without warning.

Immediately afterwards, a man wearing a Confucian robe and flowing hair slowly emerged from the broken space.

He looked indifferent, with a smile on the corner of his mouth, and kept looking at the starry sky in front of him.

It took him a long time to breathe slowly.

"The upper plane seems to be nothing more than that."

"Yeah?"

As soon as the long-haired man finished speaking, a cold voice suddenly came from all directions, carrying a creepy murderous intent to continue to enter the man's ears.

Buzz —

In the distance, ripples began to occur in the space, and the next moment, a huge creature appeared in the distance.

The aura of the creature was extremely strange, with indescribable patterns engraved on the whole body, and the flowing light flashed, and it was never seen or heard of.

"Who allowed you to come up privately in the lower ants?"

Two divine lights shot out from the eyes of the creature, looking coldly at the long-haired man in the distance.

Hearing this, the long-haired man's face remained unchanged. He looked at the creatures in the distance, and there was still a faint smile on his lips.

"Ant, I don't know how many years I have not been called this. I really miss it."

Yes, how could an existence like him who could kill from the lower plane all the way to the upper plane would be a general person.

In his life, he never failed, and he almost broke through all the way with a crushing attitude.

Even when facing the mysterious creature in the upper plane in front of him, he still had no fear in his eyes.

Some are just excited.

The long-haired man opened his hand with one hand, and a ribbon embroidered with the words Qingshui appeared in his hand.

Then, he tied up the long hair behind his head.

Immediately afterwards, a stream of terrifying aura continued to surge out of his body.

He pointed at the creatures in the distance, and his clear tone was extremely confident, "It's up to you to be the first creature I entered the upper plane and killed."

After saying that, he suddenly disappeared from the spot and rushed straight to the creatures in the distance.

In an instant, the light suddenly rose!

In this way, the picture dissipated.

Lu Daosheng no longer needs to look at the rest.

The ending is already destined.

Even if you have an invincible posture in the lower plane, you are still like an ant in the eyes of these strong men on the upper plane.

It shouldn't be like this, it shouldn't be like this.

Lu Daosheng shook his head and looked at the other person.

This muscular man is still the same. He just came to the upper plane and encountered the mysterious creature's way.

He didn't even say a word of nonsense about this and rushed up directly.

Just do it.

As for the ending, you can already know it when you look at the corpse in front of you.

Destiny is so unpredictable.

You may have a glory in the previous second, but no one knows what will happen in the next second.

Maybe you will fall into the abyss and never turn around. Maybe you will suddenly betray your relatives and become lonely.

Maybe like these two, they will face a strong man far beyond their own strength, and be beaten to death, leaving only an eternal corpse, telling the world that you have been here before.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng raised his foot and continued to walk forward.

As for these two corpses, he did not move. In his opinion, this was the glory of the two of them.

Perhaps one day in the future, their descendants can come here and take the two of them back with their own hands.

And just as Lu Daosheng didn't go far, a breath suddenly came.

Looking at the trembling space in the distance, Lu Daosheng's eyes were as calm as water.

Sure enough, it's still here.

With the faint light illuminated.

The next moment, a huge creature appeared in the distance.

He looks like a human, but he is not a human, and his whole body is full of complicated runes.

It's the creature in that picture.

At this moment, the creature was also staring at Lu Daosheng.

For the first time, there was a hint of doubt in his eyes.

"Why do you give me a feeling of uneasiness?"

A slightly heavier voice came from the mouth of the creature. Obviously, he had discovered something was wrong with Lu Daosheng.

And he was not so cautious when facing those two people.

Sure enough, wherever you go, strength will always be the king.

"Is there a possibility that in my eyes, you are like an ant?"

Lu Daosheng said calmly with expressionless face.

The creatures in front of him looked at the strong men who broke up from the lower plane as ants, but at this moment, why didn't Lu Daosheng regard him as ants?

The creatures in the distance did not speak, but did not respond.

He was thinking.

He was sure that the human being in front of him was definitely coming from the lower plane.

However, why is the opponent's strength so so? Even he can't see through it. Even when he looked at Lu Daosheng, he felt like he was staring into the abyss!

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already spoken again.

Cold words kept piercing into his ears.

"A moment, if you don't get out, you will die!"

The creature was slightly stunned, but still indifferent.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng slowly exhaled, and the entire starry sky trembled.

"A breath has come. If you don't get out, then you'll die."

Lu Daosheng seemed to have made a very casual decision.

But it was such a casual decision that directly determined the life and death of the creatures in the distance.

Buzz —

As Lu Daosheng clenched his fist with one hand towards the creatures in the distance, the starry sky began to twist violently.

At this moment, a trace of fear finally appeared in the eyes of the creatures in the distance.

run!

This was the last thought in his mind.
